segments.name: Conventional Shell Eggs
segments.description: Produces, grades, packages, markets and distributes conventional shell eggs for U.S. retail and foodservice customers.
segments.evidence: The Conventional Shell Eggs segment consists primarily of the production, grading, packaging, marketing and distribution of shell eggs sold as conventional shell eggs, which includes our brands Sunups® and Sunny Meadow®.

segments.name: Specialty Shell Eggs
segments.description: Produces and distributes cage-free, nutritionally enhanced, organic, brown, pasture-raised and free-range shell eggs for customers nationwide.
segments.evidence: The Specialty Shell Eggs segment consists primarily of the production, grading, packaging, marketing and distribution of shell eggs sold as cage -free, nutritionally enhanced , organic, brown, pasture -raised and free-range eggs.

segments.name: Prepared Foods
segments.description: Produces, packages, markets and distributes prepared foods such as egg patties, omelets, pancakes and waffles.
segments.evidence: The Prepared Foods segment consists primarily of the production, packaging, marketing and distribution of prepared foods product offerings such as pre-cooked egg patties, omelets, folded and scrambled egg formats , pancakes, waffles and specialty wraps.

revenueModel.text: Retail and foodservice customers pay the Company for shell eggs and prepared egg-based foods sold throughout much of the U.S.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's shell egg portfolio spans the full egg value ladder —from conventional to specialty, including cage-free, nutritionally enhanced, organic, brown, pasture -raised, and free-range eggs—serving both retail and foodservice customers nationwide.

changes.text: Effective in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company moved from one reportable segment to three: Conventional Shell Eggs, Specialty Shell Eggs, and Prepared Foods.
changes.evidence: Effective in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, we revised our internal reporting to change the manner in which we manage our business, which reflects a focus on managing operations based on our product categories rather than on a consolidated basis.
